acceptance: A local CedarDB TPC-DS SF0.01 run with load, power, throughput (4 streams) and maintenance is recorded, or the reproduced blocking error is recorded
If supported: tpcds_maintenance_unsupported_reason no longer covers CedarDB, a unit test pins the capability, and post-maintenance row counts match DuckDB
If unsupported: the reason string cites the reproduced error
description:
## Problem
PR #4260 enabled TPC-H refresh functions on CedarDB (supports_refresh_functions = True) and fixed RF1's explicit BEGIN inside psycopg's implicit transaction (_begin_transaction now skips BEGIN when autocommit is False). It kept CedarDB TPC-DS maintenance off through tpcds_maintenance_unsupported_reason, because the same capability flag would otherwise have switched it on unverified. Official TPC-DS requires the maintenance phase (tpc_spec._REQUIRED_PHASES['tpcds'] includes maintenance), so official TPC-DS runs are refused on CedarDB.

## Decision gate
Run TPC-DS maintenance on CedarDB at SF0.01 locally (mocker, pinned image) with the #4260 transaction fix in place:
- If it passes and data is consistent after maintenance, remove the unsupported reason and add CedarDB to the maintenance-capable set with a test.
- If CedarDB lacks a needed SQL feature, record the exact error and keep the reason, citing the reproduced error (same standard as the release-gate compatibility skips).

## Guardrails
- Do not enable maintenance without a passing local run.
- Verify row counts of the affected fact and dimension tables before and after maintenance against DuckDB on the same data.
- Do not touch the TPC-H refresh path that #4260 verified.
